text: Super clean and functional app. I would like to have the option to have an accountability friend, so that we see each others progress, also it would make sense for this to be provided in the free subscription, so that both friends don't have to buy pro if they don't want to just to share progress, other apps have this for free but aren't so clean and pretty, so I would like this option here...
